description: This file implements the SQL store for managing Mattermost's sidebar categories and channels, including creation, updating, migration, and deletion of categories and associated channels, with support for user preferences and orphaned channels.

classes.name: SqlChannelStore
classes.description: Struct implementing the SQL store for channel sidebar categories and channels.

methods.name: CreateInitialSidebarCategories
methods.description: Creates default sidebar categories for a user and team, migrating favorites and setting up default categories.

methods.name: migrateMembershipToSidebar
methods.description: Migrates user memberships to sidebar channels, inserting them into SidebarChannels table.

methods.name: migrateFavoritesToSidebarT
methods.description: Migrates user favorite channels from preferences to sidebar channels.

methods.name: MigrateFavoritesToSidebarChannels
methods.description: Bulk migration of user favorite channels into sidebar channels, used during migration.

methods.name: CreateSidebarCategory
methods.description: Creates a new custom sidebar category with optional channels, updating order and preferences.

methods.name: completePopulatingCategoryT
methods.description: Ensures orphaned channels are included in a category.

methods.name: completePopulatingCategoriesT
methods.description: Ensures orphaned channels are included in multiple categories.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a sidebar category with its channels by ID.

methods.name: getSidebarCategoryT
methods.description: Internal method to get a sidebar category with channels from a specific database connection.

methods.name: getSidebarCategoriesT
methods.description: Retrieves all categories and channels for a user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategoriesForTeamForUser
methods.description: Public method to get sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategories
methods.description: Public method to get sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategoryOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the order of sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: getSidebarCategoryOrderT
methods.description: Internal method to get category order from database.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategoryOrder
methods.description: Updates the order of sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategories
methods.description: Updates multiple sidebar categories and their channels, maintaining consistency.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarChannelCategoryOnMove
methods.description: Removes a channel from sidebar categories when moved to a different team.

methods.name: ClearSidebarOnTeamLeave
methods.description: Removes all sidebar entries for a user leaving a team.

methods.name: DeleteSidebarCategory
methods.description: Deletes a custom sidebar category and its channels.

methods.name: DeleteAllSidebarChannelForChannel
methods.description: Deletes all sidebar channel entries for a specific channel.
